title: Bus coureurs pour les sites de départ — Diagonale des Fous 2026
claims: On Thursday 15 October 2026 a western runner-bus route leaves the car park opposite Cinepalmes in Saint-Denis at 17:10 and reaches Ravine Blanche in Saint-Pierre at 20:00.

The western route calls at La Possession 17:25, Le Port 17:45, Saint-Paul 18:10, Boucan Canot 18:25, Saint-Gilles-les-Bains 18:35, Hermitage 18:45, La Saline 18:55, Saint-Leu 19:10, Étang Salé 19:30 and Saint-Louis 19:45.

An eastern runner-bus route leaves Sainte-Marie town hall at 16:15 and reaches Ravine Blanche at 20:00 via Sainte-Suzanne, Saint-André, Bras Panon, Saint-Benoît, Sainte-Anne, Sainte-Rose, Saint-Philippe, Saint-Joseph and Petite-Île.
Fifteen runner buses are escorted by the motorised brigade and local police, and carpooling is also recommended.
Runners must register for the bus option in their runner area on the website.
